How we check every listing

      
    
        
  1. It has to come from you. We confirm with the official Instagram, website or email on your public profile.
    2. 
        
  2. It has to match what you post publicly. Days, times and addresses are checked against your own posts or site.
    3. 
        
  3. Only the organizer can change or cancel an event. Reports about someone else’s event are checked with them first.
    4. 
        
  4. New listings start as “Confirm first” until we’ve seen them posted publicly a couple of times.
    5. 
      

      
We list public business details only. DJs and private teachers never get a phone number on the site.
